mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatbot_conversations ( user_id, title, revision, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 9 HOUR, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 9 HOUR )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, revision, created_at, updated_at FROM chatbot_conversations WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.message_id, m.conversation_id, m.role, m.content, m.processing_status AS status, m.created_at FROM chatbot_messages m JOIN chatbot_conversations c ON c.conversation_id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.message_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE chatbot_conversations SET title = #{title}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 9 HOUR WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatbot_messages ( conversation_id, role, content, processing_status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, COALESCE( #{createdAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 9 HOUR ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE chatbot_messages SET processing_status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND role = 'USER' AND processing_status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE chatbot_messages SET processing_status = 'FAILED' WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND role = 'USER' AND processing_status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE chatbot_messages SET processing_status = 'FAILED' WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND role = 'USER' AND processing_status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at < TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, -#{timeoutSeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 9 HOUR )

UPDATE chatbot_conversations SET deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 9 HOUR, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) + INTERVAL 9 HOUR, revision = revision + 1 WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
